comparison.objective: Captures a reference angle with a passive bevel gauge, transfers it, and draws a matching line; the candidate sets and locks a gripper opening stop.
comparison.physical_skill: PR-216 requires fitting two faces, carrying a friction-hinged gauge without angle loss, seating it, and guided marking; the candidate requires two-tool coaxial adjustment and countertorque.
comparison.success_condition: PR-216 grades captured-angle retention and line coverage, gap, angular, and stray-mark tolerances; the candidate grades locked opening angle, drift, repeated motion, hardware retention, and released clearance.
comparison.reason: Angle is common only as a measured quantity; PR-216 tests passive capture, transport, and marking, not locknut reaction control or functional cycling.

review_notes: Bevel gauge angle capture/transfer. Compare measurement/locking, all original versions; verify friction hinge versus lockscrew claim.
